2026-09-02 07:04:25.129 | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-02 07:04:25.129 |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-09-02 07:04:25.129 | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
